WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.gender,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM Customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN Orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender
),
customer_shares AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        gender,
        order_count,
        1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS order_share
    FROM customer_order_counts
),
shares_above_average AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        gender,
        order_count,
        order_share,
        order_share - AVG(order_share) OVER () AS share_above_average
    FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    gender,
    order_count,
    order_share,
    share_above_average
FROM shares_above_average
WHERE share_above_average > 0
ORDER BY share_above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
